lines.trans: Did you see how delighted my old professor looked when he spotted the green shutters wide open, Zhou?!
Before he even took three steps in, he spotted our old walnut piano right through the glass!

words.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

lines.trans: And he called out your name right away on the train platform, did he not, Hao?
Before I had even lowered the compass welcome sign, he called me front-row notebook!
He whispered that talking all along the long train ride left his voice a bit hoarse.
No wonder he patted his coat pocket—he brought along a toast card for us!

words.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

lines.trans: First let me take out our family's green guest ledger, opened right to May thirty years ago.

words.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

lines.trans: Could we lend him brass key number eight off the wooden board for the afternoon?
Room Eight happens to be free tonight—even better, Qing, Room Eight is on the house for the night!
At the front gate he also handed Peng a flat wooden parcel wrapped in brown kraft paper.
Ooh, a flat parcel from a master mapmaker? Wait until after cake to unwrap it—no peeking!
Bring out the brass compass and key number eight—Room Nine is ready for music!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 台阶上放着一个用白纸包着的小木盒。
examples.trans: A small wooden box wrapped in white paper was sitting on the steps.

examples.text: 哪怕只有一个客人入住，我们也会准备好热腾腾的早饭。
examples.trans: Even if only one guest checks in, we still prepare a piping hot breakfast.

meanings.en: all the way; the whole journey
meanings.note: Pinyin: yí lù. Used in travel wishes and descriptions of a trip.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 祝您今天一路平安！
examples.trans: Wishing you a safe journey all the way today!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: strict modal expression prohibiting an action

examples.text: 不是说过实习生不许进总编室吗？
examples.trans: Did you not say interns are not allowed inside the chief editor's office?

examples.text: 录影开始以后不许随便走动。
examples.trans: Once taping begins, walking around freely is not allowed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

examples.text: 这是交给啊。
examples.trans: This is hand over to.

examples.text: 那个交给好。
examples.trans: That hand over to is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Verb jiè ('lend or borrow').

examples.text: 这本资料借你看一下。
examples.trans: I will lend you this file to look over.

examples.text: 能借你的钢笔用一下吗？
examples.trans: May I borrow your pen for a moment?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tōu kàn. Compound verb joining 偷 ('secretly, by stealth') and 看 ('look').

examples.text: 没走完四条线索以前，谁也不准在前台提前偷看信封！
examples.trans: Before walking all four clues, nobody is allowed to sneak an early peek at the envelope at the front desk!

examples.text: 周经理忍住好奇心，一眼也没有偷看背面的答案。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou held back his curiosity and did not sneak a single peek at the answer on the back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎn fèi. Literally 'exempt from fee'.

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

examples.text: 住店客人早上都可以免费喝热茶。
examples.trans: Overnight guests can enjoy complimentary hot tea every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn bèi. Used for preparing rooms, breakfast, or plans.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū. Core directional verb meaning 'outward'.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng cái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 刚才那一刻 ('that moment just now').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

related.gloss: that moment just now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì tú. Functions both as a field noun (制图教授, cartography professor) and as an action ('to draw maps').

examples.text: 真棒，志豪！你的制图老教授听了，肯定笑得合不拢嘴！
examples.trans: Bravo, Hao! Your old cartography professor is going to smile from ear to ear!

examples.text: 老先生拿出随身带的制图铅笔，在餐巾纸角上画了条小巷。
examples.trans: The elderly gentleman took out his drafting pencil and sketched a small lane on the corner of a napkin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Noun qiánpái ('front row of seats').

examples.text: 以前常请大学生做前排观众。
examples.trans: College students were often invited as front-row audience.

examples.text: 请拿到票的同学坐在前排。
examples.trans: Students with tickets please sit in the front row.

meanings.en: zest; energy; unmistakable look of excitement or effort
meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn er. Colloquial erhua form of 劲; often follows an adjective like 高兴劲儿 (look of pure delight) or 认真劲儿 (air of earnestness).

examples.text: 周经理，您看见我老教授瞧见绿百叶窗敞开时那高兴劲儿了吗？！
examples.trans: Did you see how delighted my old professor looked when he spotted the green shutters wide open, Zhou?!

examples.text: 看小美揉面糊那股麻利劲儿，两刻钟内准能送进烤箱。
examples.trans: Look at that brisk energy as Mei mixes the batter—she'll have it in the oven within half an hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāo. As a verb, 'wrap up' (白纸包着); as a noun/classifier, 'bag/packet'.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Small paper card for notes, gifts, or study.

examples.text: 礼物盒里放着一张小卡片。
examples.trans: Inside the gift box sits a small card.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了几句祝福。
examples.trans: He wrote a few wishes on the card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chī. Everyday verb for eating meals, bread, or snacks.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个名字 ('a name').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.en: to become hoarse (of a voice); mute
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎ. Frequently used after 嗓子 (throat/voice) in 嗓子哑了 ('one's voice has gone hoarse').

examples.text: 他悄悄说长途火车上一路聊下来，嗓子都有点哑了。
examples.trans: He whispered that talking all along the long train ride left his voice a bit hoarse.

examples.text: 周经理欢迎客人讲了太久，赶忙喝口温薄荷茶润润快哑的嗓子。
examples.trans: Zhou welcomed guests for so long that he hurried to sip warm mint tea for his raspy voice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎn. Used for calling out to someone across a courtyard or street.

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

examples.text: 有人在大门口喊你的名字。
examples.trans: Someone is calling your name at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎng zi. Everyday spoken word used for both physical throat comfort and vocal quality.

examples.text: 他悄悄说长途火车上一路聊下来，嗓子都有点哑了。
examples.trans: He whispered that talking all along the long train ride left his voice a bit hoarse.

examples.text: 梧桐巷的各位朋友，原谅我坐长途火车嗓子累了，请小晴替我道声谢。
examples.trans: Friends of Wutong Lane, forgive my tired train-ride voice and let Qing share my thanks.

meanings.en: see you later; catch you soon
meanings.note: Pinyin: huítóu jiàn. Casual, friendly parting phrase where 回头 figuratively means 'in a little while' or 'later on'; common among coworkers and friends expecting to meet again soon.

examples.text: 我先去开会了，咱们回头见！
examples.trans: I'm heading off to my meeting first — see you later!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，回头见！
examples.trans: It was great chatting today; see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài tào. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件外套 ('a coat').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位大师 ('a master').

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

examples.text: 那位木匠真是一位修老家具的大师。
examples.trans: That carpenter is truly a master at restoring old furniture.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén kǒu. Location noun built from 大门 ('main gate') + 口 ('entranceway').

examples.text: 送货车停在客栈大门口等我们签字。
examples.trans: The delivery van parked at the inn's front gate waiting for us to sign.

examples.text: 大门口的两盆绿植物刚浇过水。
examples.trans: The two pots of green plants by the main gate were just watered.

meanings.en: to perform music; strike up a tune for an occasion
meanings.note: Pinyin: zòu yuè. Verb-object compound where 奏 means 'play an instrument' and 乐 (yuè) means 'music.'

examples.text: 把黄铜罗盘和八号钥匙拿出去吧——九号房也准备好奏乐啦！
examples.trans: Bring out the brass compass and key number eight—Room Nine is ready for music!

examples.text: 茶点摆齐以后，宋老师和志豪立刻坐到琴凳前准备奏乐。
examples.trans: Once the tea and cakes were set out, Song and Hao sat right down at the piano bench to play.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 家里地方 ('home').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Used for carrying keys, tools, or luggage with you.

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān cuì. Suggests cutting straight to a clean solution.

examples.text: 大门门铃响了。干脆有力的一下。
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm, decisive ring.

examples.text: 既然雨这么大，干脆留下来吃晚饭吧。
examples.trans: Since it is raining this hard, you might as well stay for dinner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Adverb qiāoqiāo ('quietly, without a sound').

examples.text: 不属于我的心意，就悄悄地珍藏起来吧。
examples.trans: Feelings that cannot be mine I will quietly tuck away.

examples.text: 她怕打扰大家开会，悄悄从后门走了进来。
examples.trans: Not wanting to interrupt, she slipped quietly in the back door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎn. Describes thin, flattened objects (扁铁棒 'flat iron bar', 扁包裹 'flat parcel'); contrast 平 ('level, even').

examples.text: 老陈把扁铁棒轻轻伸进第三块石板的角落下面。
examples.trans: Chen slid the flat iron bar gently underneath the corner of the third flagstone.

examples.text: 志鹏在大门口接过了一个用牛皮纸包着的扁木头包裹。
examples.trans: At the gate Peng received a flat wooden parcel wrapped in brown kraft paper.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chāi. Used for tearing open envelopes, unwrapping packages, or dismantling old structures.

examples.text: 十二点以后再拆吧，老板！看钟：差五分十二点！
examples.trans: Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to twelve!

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pāi. Used for clapping (拍手), patting someone, and taking photos (拍照).

examples.text: 您拍一下手——听，街上的声音多安静！
examples.trans: Clap your hands once—listen, how quiet the street sounds!

examples.text: 大家拍拍手，欢迎新同事！
examples.trans: Everyone, give a clap to welcome our new colleague!

examples.text: 义务？跟我谈恋爱，用不着拿出尽义务的心态。
examples.trans: Duty? Dating me doesn't call for the mindset of fulfilling an obligation!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pronounced jiàoshòu; placed after a surname when used as a form of address (e.g., 方教授 'Professor Fang').
Pronounced jiàoshòu (or jiāoshòu in older usage) as a formal transitive verb meaning 'to impart knowledge or skills'.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 小谷同学，先来认识一下学位评委的各位教授。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, come meet the professors on the degree committee first.

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个时期 ('a time').

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

examples.text: 不看纸条，他走进大门时我说什么？
examples.trans: Without my notes, what do I say when he walks in the gate?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì bú shì. A-not-A affirmative-negative question tag; bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 我们俩是不是刚升职当上正式试吃员了？
examples.trans: Did the two of us just get promoted to official taste testers?

examples.text: 你是不是把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下了？
examples.trans: Didn't you tuck the green guest book under your arm?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Describes arriving late or evening time.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu diǎn. Placed BEFORE an adjective/feeling verb (有点冷 'a bit cold')—contrast 一点 after adjectives.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
examples.trans: No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù pái. Combines 木 ('wooden') + 牌 ('signboard/plaque'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 看看我们准备挂在街门上的小木牌——简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: Look at the small wooden sign we are hanging on the street gate—short, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 小晴用端正的黑字在木牌上写下了咖啡角的营业时间。
examples.trans: Qing wrote the café corner's opening hours on the wooden sign in neat black lettering.

本.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

meanings.en: measure word for books and notebooks
meanings.note: Pinyin: běn. Counts bound volumes, notebooks, ledgers, and albums (一本书, 一本账本).

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本旧乐谱。
examples.trans: Two old music books sit on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Counts footsteps or stages (一步 'one step').

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē. Measure word (量词): 列 (liè), e.g. 一列火车 ('a train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Used literally for cards or figuratively for leverage.

examples.text: 这是我们谈判手里最后一张牌了。
examples.trans: This is the very last card in our hand for the talks.

examples.text: 把好牌打好，才能赢得最后的胜利。
examples.trans: Only by playing good cards well can you win in the end.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niú pí zhǐ. Literally 牛皮 ('cowhide/buff leather') + 纸 ('paper'), named for its tough tear-resistant fiber and tan leather colour; measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 卷 (juǎn).

examples.text: 只要我们在走廊地上铺好牛皮纸，刷油漆就不会弄脏地板。
examples.trans: As long as we lay brown kraft paper on the hallway floor, painting the shutters won't spot the floor.

examples.text: 书店老板用结实的牛皮纸把那本旧乐谱整整齐齐包好了。
examples.trans: The bookshop owner wrapped the old music book neatly in sturdy brown kraft paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng jì bù. Measure word: 本 (běn), e.g. 一本绿皮登记簿 ('a green-bound guest ledger').

examples.text: 我先把家里那本绿皮客人登记簿拿出去，正好翻到三十年前的五月。
examples.trans: First let me take out our family's green guest ledger, opened right to May thirty years ago.

examples.text: 老教授摸着登记簿泛黄的纸页，一眼就找出了自己当年的签名。
examples.trans: Tracing the yellowed page of the guest register, the old professor spotted his old signature immediately.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi yè chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇百叶窗 ('a louvered shutter').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 午后把木百叶窗放下一半，屋里既凉快又柔和。
examples.trans: Lowering the wooden shutters halfway at noon keeps the room cool and soft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张皮 ('a piece of leather').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

related.gloss: a piece of leather (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个盒子 ('a small box').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 这个小木头盒子装的是老照片。
examples.trans: This little wooden box holds old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn jiàn. Result compound: 看 ('look') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually see'.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn. Counts quick looks after verbs of looking (看一眼, 扫一眼 'take a quick look').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 你瞧，窗台上的茉莉花今天早上全开了！
examples.trans: Look—the jasmine flowers on the windowsill all bloomed this morning!

examples.text: 快去瞧瞧，是谁把这包点心留在门廊的长椅上了？
examples.trans: Go take a quick look—who left this parcel of pastries on the porch bench?

meanings.en: toast; short congratulatory speech before raising glasses or cups
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù jiǔ cí. Measure word: 篇 (piān) or 段 (duàn), e.g. 一段祝酒词 ('a toast').

examples.text: 难怪他刚才拍拍外套口袋——他给咱们带了一张祝酒词卡片呢！
examples.trans: No wonder he patted his coat pocket—he brought along a toast card for us!

examples.text: 小晴替老教授念完祝酒词，院子里立刻响起一片热烈的掌声。
examples.trans: Once Qing finished reading the old professor's toast aloud, warm applause erupted across the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng. Describes an unoccupied room or bare floor.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个站台 ('a station platform').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 谁能想到，星期一早上志豪在二站台拿错了蓝箱子。
examples.trans: Who would have thought that on Monday morning Hao grabbed the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ jì běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本笔记本 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ. Describes green leaves, doors, or green tea.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó pán. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn) or 个 (gè). Joins 罗 ('net, to gather') + 盘 ('plate, tray').

examples.text: 抽屉深处藏着一面古董航海罗盘。
examples.trans: Hidden deep in the drawer is an antique nautical compass.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年就是用这面罗盘在山里测绘的。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor used this very compass to survey in the mountains back in the day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér qiě. Adds a further supporting point.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáo. Everyday verb for friendly conversation (聊聊 'have a chat').

examples.text: 两位慢慢聊——整个院子都留给你们。
examples.trans: Take all the time you need—the whole courtyard is yours.

examples.text: 坐在树下跟朋友聊聊天真舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting under the tree chatting with friends is so pleasant.

meanings.en: walnut wood; dark fine-grained timber used for pianos and frames
meanings.note: Pinyin: hú táo mù. Modifies furniture directly, e.g. 胡桃木钢琴 ('walnut piano').

examples.text: 快告诉我志豪躲哪儿去了——咱们得在那架胡桃木钢琴前实打实练够三十分钟！
examples.trans: Now tell me where Hao is hiding—we need thirty solid minutes at that walnut piano!

examples.text: 这张地图镶在温润的胡桃木画框里，挂在白墙上特别精神。
examples.trans: Set inside its warm walnut frame, the map looks striking hanging on the white lobby wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn. Core verb in 认识 ('know'), 认出来 ('recognize'), and 认输 ('admit defeat').

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车站 ('a station').

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

examples.text: 雨天打车难，我们早点去车站吧。
examples.trans: Hailing a cab in the rain takes longer, so let's head to the station early.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mài. Action verb for lifting one's foot and stepping forward or down (往下迈 'step down', 迈进大门 'step through the gate').

examples.text: 我从矮凳往下迈的时候，右脚鞋子在最下面那根横档上滑了一下。
examples.trans: When I stepped down from the low stool, my right shoe slipped on the bottom rung.

examples.text: 周经理整理好领带，微笑着迈出大门去迎接市政厅的办事员。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou straightened his tie and stepped out the front gate with a smile to greet the City Hall clerk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè yàng. Points to a manner or result close at hand; at the start of a clause it means 'that way, so that' (这样就轻了 'that way it gets light').

examples.text: 先拿最上面一层，这样书架就轻了。
examples.trans: Take the top shelf first, so the bookcase gets lighter.

examples.text: 城里那封信要的，就是这样一个房间！
examples.trans: And this is exactly the room the city letter asked for!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把钥匙 ('a key').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cháng tú. Modifies nouns directly, e.g. 长途火车 ('long-distance train').

examples.text: 他悄悄说长途火车上一路聊下来，嗓子都有点哑了。
examples.trans: He whispered that talking all along the long train ride left his voice a bit hoarse.

examples.text: 老教授坐了大半天长途火车来到成都，一进院子就精神了。
examples.trans: After riding a long-distance train half the day to Chengdu, the old professor perked right up on entering the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé. Describes being separated by a wall, door, or interval of time (隔着).

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
examples.trans: Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán guài. Close cousin of 怪不得 ('hard to blame it—no wonder!').

examples.text: 难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
examples.trans: No wonder you listened in the attic last night for car sounds from the street!

examples.text: 甚至星期二您还打电话提过白纸包的事！
examples.trans: Even after you called us on Tuesday about the white parcel!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo xìng. Classic greeting word in 很高兴认识你 ('Nice to meet you').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
examples.trans: We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
